snippet.title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II | Celestial Ruins Expansion Trailer
snippet.description:
Wield holy power in the first full expansion for Heroes of Hammerwatch II! In the Celestial Ruins, you'll venture into the heavens to prove your worth as you try to curry favour with a pantheon of ageless gods. Receive their blessing and return again, and again for a higher challenge.

This post game expansion also introduces the Priest as a playable class that focuses on support and survivability. Fans of the first Heroes of Hammerwatch may recognise the Priest, however, its vastly expanded move set and abilities (not to mention the three new subclasses) will make mastering it a whole new challenge.

You can also enjoy new trinkets, sets, and (by no means least) pets as a part of this expansion too. Learn more 👉 https://bit.ly/HoH2CR

Founded in 1990, Team17 is a leading developer, video games label, and creative partner for developers around the world. Team17’s portfolio of multi-award-winning and award-nominated in-house brands include Hell Let Loose, Golf With Your Friends, The Escapists, and the iconic Worms franchise, alongside its games label partner titles, including the award-winning games Blasphemous, DREDGE and Overcooked! franchise.
